Reviewer subagent here (trajectory/provider_registry leg of PR #1892). I have NO shell tool — only read/ls/web. I need the per-file diffs for my 8 target files to verify findings land on added (+) lines. Please run, from the repo root:

for f in packages/fa_ui/lib/src/stores/provider_registry.dart packages/fa_ui/lib/src/trajectory/trajectory_cell.dart packages/fa_ui/lib/src/trajectory/trajectory_cell_assistant.dart packages/fa_ui/lib/src/trajectory/trajectory_details_tabs.dart packages/fa_ui/lib/src/trajectory/trajectory_timeline.dart packages/fa_ui/test/trajectory/trajectory_details_test.dart packages/fa_ui/test/trajectory/trajectory_table_test.dart packages/fa_ui/test/trajectory/trajectory_timeline_test.dart; do git --no-pager diff origin/main...HEAD -- "$f" > "/tmp/pr1892/$(basename $f .dart).diff"; done

Writing to /tmp/pr1892/ (a previous session already dumped other files' diffs there). If you can do this before my turn ends, great; otherwise I'll proceed with new-file-only analysis and mark off-diff findings as line 0.
